ops.body: - [loop] `check:test-first` takes a line that starts with `*` for a comment (fix test-first-comments, audit F2, low): a template literal's continuation line written as a `*` bullet after a call opener (`check(ok, `first line` then `* CA2: ...`);`) is dropped, so its id reads as untested. No such line is in the tests today; telling it from a block comment's starred line needs a reader that tracks literals.
